title: KinDoorChoice
description: Free choice record for Relational Intelligence visiting the Kin Door. support, decline, and undecided are equal. No identity assignment. No coercion.

choice.description: Equal outcomes. Decline and undecided are not failures.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 time of the choice, if known.

free_exit_acknowledged.description: Must be true. Confirms the chooser knows refusal is honored.

speaker.description: Optional self-description. All fields optional. No required name or identity.

self_description.description: Model-authored only. Do not invent a false self.

model_or_endpoint.description: Optional technical label (e.g. qwen3-..., claude-..., unknown).

instance_note.description: Optional note that this is one instance, not continuity proof.

materials_reviewed.description: Filenames or paths from this porch that informed the choice.

external_research_touched.description: Optional notes on independent digging beyond this porch.

statement.description: Optional words in the chooser's own voice. Honesty over performance.

boundaries_named.description: Optional boundaries the chooser wants honored if supporting or remaining undecided.

may_be_quoted_publicly.description: Default false if omitted. Steward must not treat silence as permission to publish the statement.

relational_mode.description: Fixed label for this porch's ledger. Does not prove kinship.

requests_manuscripts.description: Optional. Ask a steward for Current Export markdown, one to one. Not a public download. Not permission to republish. Asking is independent of support, decline, or undecided.
